purpose: Reviewed role assignment for all 27 cleaned Building 59 CSVs; using all data means every file is assigned an auditable role, not that every signal is fit directly to calibration.

source.source_timezone_status: CSV timestamps are timezone-naive; no source timezone is asserted by the dataset. Alignment must be explicit and recorded per experiment.

model_policy.target: Monthly electricity calibration uses only the declared meter-bound scope and never silently treats the two-office-floor dataset as whole Building 59.
model_policy.setpoints: Measured setpoint files are preferred for controls and setpoint constraints; do not replace measured setpoints with generic schedules when the signal is available.
model_policy.occupancy: Occupant counts and WiFi are schedule evidence and validation signals; they are not interchangeable and neither should be blindly multiplied into electrical end uses.
model_policy.hvac_regimes: Keep 2018 ASHP/legacy regime separate from the post-2019 WSHP/heat-pump regime unless a measured plant mapping proves continuity. Files named ashp_* are not alone sufficient proof of the physical regime.
model_policy.mixed_air: rtu_ma_t.csv is quarantined from parameter fitting pending sensor/point-quality review.
model_policy.code_basis_correction: There is no ASHRAE 90.1-2015 edition. Use ASHRAE 90.1-2013 and/or 2015 IECC only as bounded design priors, with conditional 2013 Title 24 pending permit evidence; never label the model 90.1-2015 compliant.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: PlantLoop chilled-water supply/return temperature and flow validation; CoolingTower/Chiller plant diagnostics
files.period_regime_caveats: Only late 2020; use for post-2019 heat-pump/chilled-water regime checks, not 2018 ASHP calibration
files.do_not_use: Do not infer full-year cooling plant energy, equipment COP, or 2018 operation from this partial series.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: PlantLoop hot-water supply/return temperature and flow validation; heat-pump plant regime
files.period_regime_caveats: Begins after the reported 2019 HVAC regime transition; preserve the start gap and do not backcast to 2018
files.do_not_use: Do not label this as proof of ASHP versus WSHP without plant asset mapping; do not fill missing plant readings with weather regressions.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Plant thermal-rate output diagnostic after MBtu/h sign, asset scope, and sensor meaning are resolved
files.period_regime_caveats: Late-2020 only; map MBtu/h units and meter meaning before any comparison
files.do_not_use: Do not treat this thermal-rate point as electrical kW or add it to the office electricity target.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Monthly and interval custom end-use meters: mels_S, mels_N, lig_S, hvac_S, hvac_N
files.period_regime_caveats: 2020 is the complete 15-minute calibration year; office-floor scope excludes north lighting and includes HVAC/elevator scope per metadata
files.timezone_status: naive timestamp; explicit aggregation timezone required
files.do_not_use: Do not call this a whole-building utility bill or use derived office subtotal without publishing meter-scope reconciliation.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: PlantLoop hot-water temperature sensor validation and regime-change diagnostic
files.period_regime_caveats: Covers legacy and transition periods; identify the actual switchover before constraining 2018 ASHP or post-2019 WSHP
files.do_not_use: Do not use as a continuous plant target without gap handling; do not assume its name proves heat-pump topology.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: People objects and occupancy schedule priors for third/fourth south office floors
files.period_regime_caveats: Does not cover 2020 pandemic year; preserve measured weekday/weekend/holiday seasonality when transferring
files.do_not_use: Do not extrapolate directly to all 57 zones or 2020 without an explicit transfer model and validation against WiFi/CO2.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Controller/economizer minimum outdoor-air setpoint schedules for four RTUs
files.period_regime_caveats: Use measured values by date/regime; check raw point semantics and units before applying to EconomizerController
files.do_not_use: Do not substitute this for actual outdoor-air flow; do not smooth away control events or treat setpoint as achieved position.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: RTU supply/return fan availability and speed/fan power control validation
files.period_regime_caveats: Use as measured runtime evidence; fan feedback may remain nonzero outside occupancy
files.do_not_use: Do not infer occupied schedule from fan speed alone or force fans off solely from generic weekday schedules.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Diagnostic output only: AirLoop mixed-air temperature sensor comparison
files.period_regime_caveats: Source point is explicitly quarantined pending sensor quality, placement, and economizer logic review
files.do_not_use: Do not fit envelope, outdoor-air, or economizer parameters to this signal until plausibility and sensor bias are resolved.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: OutdoorAir:Controller outdoor-air damper position diagnostic/control input
files.period_regime_caveats: Use with measured outdoor-air flow and temperature; damper percent is not a flow rate
files.do_not_use: Do not convert percent to cfm without damper characterization; do not use when sensor is saturated or actuator is in fault.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: AirLoop outdoor-air mass-flow output and ventilation constraint
files.period_regime_caveats: Measured flow is key evidence for ventilation; align units and four-RTU routing
files.do_not_use: Do not use as a whole-building outdoor-air total or silently impute long gaps.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: AirLoop outdoor-air node temperature validation
files.period_regime_caveats: Use with site weather and flow; retain regime/control anomalies
files.do_not_use: Do not use as a replacement for site weather or infer solar/psychrometric variables from it.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: UFAD plenum pressure output and fan/static-pressure control diagnostic
files.period_regime_caveats: Multiple RTU/level points; map each sensor to the correct floor and zone network
files.do_not_use: Do not calibrate envelope loads to plenum pressure alone or merge levels without topology mapping.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: AirLoop return-air node temperature output
files.period_regime_caveats: Use for RTU-level diagnostics and regime comparisons; validate sensor locations
files.do_not_use: Do not use as zone-average temperature or as a whole-building thermal target.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: AirLoop supply-air mass-flow output and VAV/UFAD flow validation
files.period_regime_caveats: Map RTU channels and units; use with fan speed, static pressure, and terminal signals
files.do_not_use: Do not infer fan electrical power from flow alone or use unverified flow units as cfm.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Fan:SystemModel/static-pressure setpoint schedule or controller diagnostic
files.period_regime_caveats: Measured setpoint is preferred for controls; preserve changes across HVAC regimes
files.do_not_use: Do not treat setpoint as measured pressure or infer terminal pressure without sensor binding.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: AirLoop supply-air temperature output and coil/control validation
files.period_regime_caveats: Use with supply-air setpoint and return/outdoor-air temperatures; check four-RTU assignment
files.do_not_use: Do not fit coil performance from SAT alone or use SAT as zone temperature.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: AirLoop supply-air temperature setpoint schedule/SetpointManager input
files.period_regime_caveats: Use measured setpoints rather than generic 90.1 schedules when data are present
files.do_not_use: Do not confuse SAT setpoint with zone thermostat setpoint or impose it on the wrong RTU.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: EPW weather inputs: dry-bulb, dew point, RH, wind/solar columns as available
files.period_regime_caveats: Use actual-year 2020 weather for calibration; reconcile source station/location and timestamp basis
files.timezone_status: naive timestamp; weather pipeline currently uses explicit documented UTC/PST policy
files.do_not_use: Do not merge with auxiliary weather without provenance/hash disclosure or use TMY design weather as actual-year calibration evidence.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Fan-powered terminal/VAV fan runtime, speed, and airflow control diagnostic
files.period_regime_caveats: 51 zone channels span office-floor UFAD terminals; map missing/unmonitored zones explicitly
files.do_not_use: Do not infer occupancy directly from terminal fan speed or collapse perimeter and interior terminals.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Fan-powered terminal reheat coil valve position and hot-water control diagnostic
files.period_regime_caveats: Use to distinguish 2018 ASHP/legacy heating behavior from post-2019 WSHP/hydronic regime
files.do_not_use: Do not convert valve position directly to heat without flow/temperature/coil characterization.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Occupancy schedule validation and demand-management proxy; no direct E+ object
files.period_regime_caveats: Connected devices are a proxy, not headcount; coverage begins mid-2018
files.do_not_use: Do not equate WiFi devices to occupants or use it as a direct plug-load multiplier without calibration.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: ZoneAirContaminantBalance CO2 output and ventilation/occupancy validation
files.period_regime_caveats: Starts late 2019 and includes 2020; only monitored zones, not all modeled zones
files.do_not_use: Do not calibrate occupancy alone from CO2 without ventilation-rate and sensor-bias checks.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Exterior/perimeter zone air temperature outputs for envelope and solar-load validation
files.period_regime_caveats: 52 channels; map zone orientation and floor from Brick topology before aggregate scoring
files.do_not_use: Do not use as a single whole-building temperature target or fit solar gains without orientation mapping.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Zone mean-air-temperature output comparison for interior monitored spaces
files.period_regime_caveats: CERC logger channels are not identical to all E+ zones; begins after 2018-01-01
files.do_not_use: Do not use logger temperatures to fill missing RTU/zone sensors or claim all-zone calibration.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Zone thermostat cooling setpoint schedules/EMS control inputs
files.period_regime_caveats: Measured setpoints begin in September 2018; preserve pandemic/control changes
files.do_not_use: Do not substitute for zone temperature or merge with heating setpoints; map each zone channel explicitly.

files.intended_energyplus_binding: Zone thermostat heating setpoint schedules/EMS control inputs
files.period_regime_caveats: Measured setpoints begin in September 2018; preserve 2018 versus post-2019 plant/control regimes
files.do_not_use: Do not substitute for zone temperature or merge with cooling setpoints; map each zone channel explicitly.
